age.evidence: Three-month-old Swiss male mice from our own colony were used.

sex.evidence: Three-month-old Swiss male mice from our own colony were used.

dosing.evidence: Ibogaine (IBO) was obtained in crystal form ... and diluted in distilled water +50 µL of tween 10 ... administrated orally (gavage). For 8 days, animals received an oral administration of either Veh or IBO at the doses of 10 mg/kg or 30 mg/kg every other day.

group_housing.evidence: Animals weighing 35-40 g were group housed (8 per cage) in polypropylene cages

day_night_flipped.evidence: controlled temperature (22-23°C) and light (12 h light, 12 h dark; lights on at 6:45am) conditions

assays.assay_description: Three-compartment CPP apparatus (two conditioning compartments 40×20×20 cm + central choice 40×10×15 cm). Mice were habituated, pre-conditioned, conditioned with ethanol (1.8 g/kg, i.p.) or ibogaine (10/30 mg/kg, p.o.), then treated with ibogaine/vehicle in the ethanol-paired compartment, and tested for priming- and context-induced reinstatement. CPP score and total distance traveled measured over 15-min sessions.

application_type.evidence: ethanol ... administered intraperitoneally (i.p.); Ibogaine ... administrated orally (gavage)

setup_habituation.evidence: Habituation (Days 1-2): For 2 consecutive days, animals were placed in the center of the apparatus with the door open with free access to both compartments for 15 min. No injection was administered.

setup_restrain.evidence: animals were placed in the center of the apparatus with the door open with free access to both compartments

food_restriction.evidence: Rodent chow ... and water were available ad libitum throughout the experiments [in home cage]; no food in CPP apparatus during testing.

water_restriction.evidence: Rodent chow ... and water were available ad libitum throughout the experiments [in home cage]; no water in CPP apparatus during testing.

time_to_assay.evidence: 5 min after ethanol injection, behavior was recorded for 15 min (priming re-exposure test); 30 min after IBO injections, mice were confined; post-conditioning, post-treatment and post-context-paired re-exposure tests were drug-free (≥24 h after last dose).

sample_size.evidence: Experiment 1: n = 8 per group (4 groups). Experiment 2: Seventy-two mice (n = 24 per group) plus SAL-SAL n = 24; subgroups of n = 16 per group for priming test and n = 8 per group for context-paired re-exposure.

outcomes.summary: Ethanol (1.8 g/kg) induced CPP; ibogaine (10 or 30 mg/kg) did not. Repeated oral ibogaine treatment in the ethanol-paired compartment blocked both ethanol-priming and ethanol/context-induced reinstatement of CPP, with no effect on locomotor activity.
outcomes.statistics: Exp1 CPP score interaction F(3,28)=6.564, p=0.0017; Exp2 pre-post F(3,92)=5.679, p=0.0013; Priming re-exposure F(3,60)=6.810, p=0.0005 (IBO10 vs VEH-EtOH p=0.017; IBO30 p=0.0004); Context-paired re-exposure F(3,26)=5.339, p=0.0053 (IBO10 p=0.02; IBO30 p=0.04).
outcomes.evidence: Treatment with IBO at the doses of 10 and 30 mg/kg blocked ethanol-induced reinstatement during the priming injection re-exposure test ... and blocked ethanol- and context-induced reinstatement.

B1_num_measures.evidence: Expression of drug-induced CPP was evidenced by the CPP score ... Total distance traveled in the CPP apparatus also was measured during tests.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: behavior was recorded for 15 min; data reported as session totals with no within-session time bins

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No transition or sequence analysis reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: Only CPP score (zone time) and distance traveled measured.

B5_social.evidence: CPP tested with focal animal alone; no social construct.

B6_cognitive.evidence: CPP requires learned association between compartment cues and drug effects.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: the time spent in each compartment was registered using the ANY-maze software (version 5.1, Stoelting)

B8_multivariate.evidence: Multiple comparisons were performed using one-way or two-way analysis of variance (ANOVA).

E1_environment_type.evidence: The CPP apparatus consisted of two conditioning compartments of equal size (40 × 20 × 20 cm) ... connected by a central choice compartment.

E2_shelter.evidence: Compartments connected by sliding doors with free access; no enclosed refuge.

E3_bedding.evidence: compartment A ... black wooden floor ... compartment B ... dark (red) smooth floor

E6_spatial.evidence: two conditioning compartments ... connected by a central choice compartment that was accessible by sliding doors

E7_social_context.evidence: animals were placed in the center of the apparatus ... no conspecifics during testing

E8_food_water.evidence: No food/water in CPP apparatus during testing.

D1_continuity.evidence: Pre-conditioning test (Day 3) ... Post-conditioning test (Day 12) ... Post-treatment test (Day 21) ... Priming injection re-exposure test (Day 22) ... Post-context-paired re-exposure test (Day 23).

D3_recording_days.evidence: Recording test days: Day 3 (preCT), Day 12 (postCT), Day 21 (post-treatment), Day 22 (priming re-exposure), Day 23 (post-context-paired re-exposure) = 5 recording days.

D4_baseline.evidence: Pre-conditioning test (Day 3): Animals were placed in the center of the apparatus ... behavior was recorded for 15 min.

D5_followup.evidence: Post-treatment test (Day 21) and post-context-paired re-exposure test (Day 23) conducted ≥24 h after the last ibogaine dose.

D6_circadian.evidence: Sessions limited to 15 min; no session spans ≥6 h.

judge_notes: All three candidates identified a single CPP assay; merged into one entry per rubric rule that CPP acquisition + extinction/treatment + reinstatement = 1 assay.

D3 recording_days: chose '2-7' (5 test recording days: D3, D12, D21, D22, D23). GLM included habituation days D1-D2 to reach 8-14, but habituation explicitly had no data collection ('No injection was administered'; described as habituation only) — these are not recording days per rubric.
Food/water_restriction set to 'during' (water/food ad libitum in home cage but not accessible in CPP apparatus), per rubric default for standard short tests.
Application_type set to 'multiple' because ethanol was i.p. and ibogaine was p.o. within the same assay protocol.
Dose_dependent: 'no' because both doses produced equivalent blockade of reinstatement (no monotonic dose-response).
n_total reconciled to 104 (Exp1: 32 + Exp2: 72 = 104); GLM's 96 omitted Exp1 IBO groups, gptoss's 128 appears to double-count.
